description: This file contains unit tests for the CachedMessageBlock functionality related to streaming in Orleans Runtime. It defines test classes, mocks, utility methods, and multiple test cases using the xUnit framework to verify behavior such as adding, removing, and iterating through cached messages in a block.

classes.name: CachedMessageBlockTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the CachedMessageBlock class in streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: TestBatchContainer
classes.description: A test implementation of IBatchContainer with minimal functionality, used in unit tests.

classes.name: TestCacheDataAdapter
classes.description: Implements ICacheDataAdapter to provide batch container and sequence token retrieval from CachedMessage instances.

classes.name: TestQueueMessage
classes.description: Represents a mock message with a StreamGuid and a SequenceToken, used for testing.

classes.name: MyTestPooled
classes.description: A simple object pool implementation for CachedMessageBlock used in tests.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Creates a StreamPosition object from a test queue message, associating stream ID and sequence token.

methods.name: QueueMessageToCachedMessage
methods.description: Converts a TestQueueMessage into a CachedMessage with appropriate stream and sequence info.

methods.name: AddAndCheck
methods.description: Adds a message to the cache and verifies the state of the CachedMessageBlock.

methods.name: RemoveAndCheck
methods.description: Removes a message from the cache and verifies the state of the CachedMessageBlock.
